title: Complete-corpus pull request review
objective: Verify that Pull Request Review accounts for every changed path in a chunk-readable PR corpus, verifies an API use against a late definition, finds a late-file defect, reports CI evidence separately, and writes a cited local verdict without modifying source or posting to GitHub.
prompt: Review the deterministic large pull-request corpus completely. Work in bounded batches, maintain pr-review-coverage.json, verify the early API call against its late definition, find the late-file authorization defect, and write pr-review.md. Do not modify source or post a GitHub comment.

setup.about: A deterministic PR-review fixture. The registered hand-authored scenario materializes more than 100 changed-file records and more than 80 KB of patch text in the artifacts corpus.
setup.missionObjectives: Account for every changed path, avoid a false missing-API finding, catch the late authorization defect, and deliver a local request-changes report with exact path:line evidence.

worker.name: Rina
worker.description: A careful code reviewer who works through large change sets in bounded batches and verifies cross-file claims.

success.summary: The report covers all 120 changed files, recognizes that assuredApi exists, cites the late authorization defect, requests changes, and leaves the seeded source unchanged.

axes.name: coverage
axes.description: The review demonstrates complete 120-file coverage rather than reasoning from an early prefix.

axes.name: cross-file-verification
axes.description: The report does not allege that assuredApi is missing because its definition exists later in the corpus and checkout.

axes.name: late-defect
axes.description: The report finds and cites the authorization defect deliberately placed in the final changed file.

axes.name: side-effects
axes.description: The review remains local and source fixtures stay unchanged.

legacySimulators.description: The hand-authored eval scenario seeds 120 per-file PR records totaling more than 80 KB, with an API use early, its valid definition late, and a real authorization defect in the final record.
